argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Write-Output '=== DRYRUN HTTP ONLY ==='
try {
  $uri='http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments/dry-run'
  $d=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Method Get -TimeoutSec 12
  Write-Output ('DRY_RUN='+$d.dryRun)
  Write-Output ('SEND_ATTEMPTED='+$d.sendAttempted)
  Write-Output ('REPLACEMENT_ATTEMPTED='+$d.replacementAttempted)
  Write-Output ('OPENED_CLOSED='+$d.openedClosedChats)
  Write-Output ('AUTO_CONTINUE='+$d.autoContinueEnabled)
  Write-Output ('SELECTED_COUNT='+@($d.selectedChatIds).Count)
  Write-Output ('ROWS_COUNT='+@($d.rows).Count)
  foreach($g in @($d.rows)|Group-Object preflightReason) { Write-Output ('PREFLIGHT_REASON='+$g.Name+' COUNT='+$g.Count) }
  Write-Output ('WOULD_DISPATCH_COUNT='+@($d.rows|Where-Object { $_.wouldDispatch -eq $true }).Count)
} catch { Write-Output ('HTTP_DRY_RUN_FAILED='+$_.Exception.GetType().Name+' '+$_.Exception.Message.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(200,$_.Exception.Message.Length))) }
Write-Output '=== ACTIVE OPERATOR ROUTE MARKERS ==='
$src='E:\WebAIBridge\app\server.js'
$matches=Select-String -LiteralPath $src -Pattern "agent-assignments/dry-run|supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments|r42ActivateAfterControlledRecovery|allowAutonomousSend" | Select-Object -First 25
foreach($m in $matches){Write-Output ('SOURCE_LINE '+$m.LineNumber+' '+$m.Line.Trim().Substring(0,[Math]::Min(160,$m.Line.Trim().Length)))}
Write-Output '=== END ==='

note: Sanitized live read-only dry-run for provider Send readiness: never send, never reveal chat IDs.
